title: Opus 5.5 is really good with threejs!
author: hyp3rclaw

comments.author: Beginning-Sign1916
comments.body: So you got opus 5.5 to generate out the entire scene with no additional tools?

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body: Yes! all assets are procedurally generated with blender mcp!

replies.author: Beginning-Sign1916
replies.body: That’s really cool do you mind sharing just a small part of your prompt for the designing on blender? I was testing out using sonnet 5 and it did a simple low poly design

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body: feed it with reference images ,or generate some then use opus 5.5 on medium and ask it to build out those specific assets in blender/using mcp and see the magic, one shotting assets usually does not work out for certain type of assets, so you have to iterate on it.

replies.author: Beginning-Sign1916
replies.body: Cool thank you so much for sharing I am so gonna try it out now!
